title: Register for the 2026 Young Dentists Forum
html:
The Young Dentists Forum returns on 5 September 2026 in Prague as part of the FDI World Dental Congress 2026.

This half-day event is dedicated to empowering the new generation of dental professionals by addressing the challenges, opportunities, and leadership skills needed to build a successful and sustainable career in dentistry.

The programme will start with a keynote lecture by Christina Radics, who will share insights on professional wellbeing, resilience, and navigating the evolving realities of modern dental practice. Eunhyuk Lee, winner of the 2026 Emerging Speaker Contest, will also take the stage to present Strategies for Esthetic and Stable Anterior Implants: A Focus on Delayed Placement.

An interactive discussion on how to thrive—not just survive—in dentistry, focusing on practical tools to maintain professional and emotional control while consistently delivering high-quality care will conclude the programme and will be followed by a networking cocktail designed to foster international connections, collaboration, and lifelong professional relationships.

How to register?

Registration for the Young Dentists Forum is free for all delegates already registered for the World Dental Congress. 

Special fees are offered to students and young dentists who graduated after August 2022.
